output.summary: The cadence slip is a capacity bottleneck at the SEC-POL-14 gate, not an engineering discipline problem. All added time sits between QA pass and AppSec sign-off (E5). Queue depth and waits grew as the single reviewer's throughput stayed flat at about 4.5 reviews a week while submissions rose (E4, E13). A full-time delegate in August cleared the queue and six releases shipped (E6). Non-gated Reporting patches kept a 14-day cadence (E12). Squad output (E7), tech debt and CI health (E11) are flat. Idle tickets are mostly 'Awaiting SecReview' (E9). Add reviewer capacity (A1). Do not suspend the gate or start punitive accountability. Risk-tiering (A4) needs review-outcome data first (Q1). Whether the gate reduces security defects is unknown (Q2).
